attrs.text: unknown_input: The why-chain treats the computed NOx PTE of 185 tpy as fact, but this value depends on undisclosed project-specific design choices: generator count (21), unit size (2,500 kW), fuel type (diesel), emission tier (Tier 2), and annual operating hours (500 h/yr). The project may use natural gas generators, Tier 4 diesel, fewer units, or accept a 100-hour/year operational limit, any of which could reduce NOx PTE below the 100 tpy major-source threshold and flip the finding from 'applies: yes' to 'applies: no'.

attrs.text: threshold_misread: The finding states the audit requirement applies only above a 75 MW threshold, but the cited evidence quote states 'The PUCT and ERCOT must complete this audit before any data center project moves forward,' with no mention of a 75 MW threshold.
